start.welcome: 👀 heyy, welcome to LearneAI — the language coach that actually talks like a human, not a textbook. 🔥 adaptive placement quiz (it will roast you) 📚 smart Leitner-box vocab system 💬 Las o Lus — a flirty AI partner you practice with 🎙️ voice messages both ways tap for the full story 👇
start.welcome_more: 🧠 how it works: 1. i figure out your real level (no lying 👀) 2. we build your daily vocab habit — your pace, your goal 3. you vibe with your AI partner in your target language 4. streaks keep you honest. miss a day… we WILL talk about it 😤 ready? pick your native language 🌍
start.choose_native: first things first — pick your native language 🌍
start.choose_native_other: type the name of your language 📝
start.choose_target: clean. now — which language are we conquering? 🎯
start.level_q: okay, be honest... how good are you at {target}? 👀
start.tease: are you sure or just being modest? let's see... 🤨
start.quiz_intro: vibe check: {n} quick questions. no googling, i'll know 🔥
start.question: Q{i}/{n} {q}
start.quiz_unavailable: quiz machine is sleeping rn 💤 so i'll trust your vibe — we'll calibrate as we go
start.verdict: {verdict} 📈 locking your level in at {level} and updating your mind-map…
start.goal_q: last thing — how many new words per day? be real 😌
start.goal_invalid: lol no. send a number between 1 and 100 🙃

learn.menu: 📚 vocab gym — let's see those gains
learn.no_due: nothing due rn 😴 your box is clear
learn.back: {word} = {translation} did you get it? be honest 👀
learn.review_done:
session done 💪 {correct}/{total} correct
next reviews scheduled — box math never lies 🧮
learn.new_done: added {n} words to your box 📥 daily goal: {done}/{goal}
learn.all_done: daily goal crushed 🏆 come back tomorrow, machine needs rest too
learn.no_new: word bank's dry rn — add words manually ✍️ or try again later
learn.add_prompt: send one word per line, like: strawberry = توت فرنگی or just the word and i'll translate 📝
learn.error: vocab machine broke 💀 try again in a sec

rp.intro: 💬 las o lus — your AI partner is texting… just vibe, reply naturally, send voice notes, whatever 😏 /end to bounce • confused? tap the button under their msgs
rp.ended:
chat archived 📁 {msgs} messages in {mins} min
your partner will miss you (probably)
rp.expired:
you ghosted for {mins} min… session auto-ended 💀
but i'm still here — keep texting and we restart fresh
rp.stt_fail: couldn't hear that 💀 send it as text?
rp.llm_fail: your partner's phone died 💀 try again in a sec
